subject: Re: Evaluation MAP & checkpoint-linked credits — proposed revisions
messages:
From: Claire O'Neill <claire@clearwaterhealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evan Torres <evan.torres@clearwaterhealth.com>, contracts@clearwaterhealth.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation plan request + checkpoint credits?

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look promising. Our team is keen to run a 6-week evaluation focused on triage summarization and secure embedding lookups. Before we lock calendar time, our procurement and security leads asked that we include a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that ties milestone acceptance to a nominal credit schedule and a brief ramp/commit window after evaluation.

High level asks from our side:
- 2 checkpoint sign-offs (week 2: ingest + baseline eval; week 5: production-like load test)
- A small credit at checkpoint 2 (to offset onboarding work) and a larger credit on successful completion at checkpoint 5
- Clear pricing for post-eval ramp (30/60/90-day ramp tiers) and any volume discounts for committed capacity

Can you share a MAP template with pricing scenarios that show credits applied against the first invoice? If possible, we’d like to get a proposal this week and schedule a 30-minute sync to finalize.

Thanks — Claire
Claire O'Neill
Head of Platform Integrations
Clearwater Health

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire O'Neill <claire@clearwaterhealth.com>
Cc: Evan Torres <evan.torres@clearwaterhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan request + checkpoint credits?

Claire — great to hear. I attached a first-pass MAP and two pricing scenarios that map credits to the checkpoints you requested. Summary here:

- 6-week evaluation: Week 2 (ingest + baseline) and Week 5 (load test) are the acceptance checkpoints.
- Credit structure (applies to first post-eval invoice):
  * Checkpoint 2: $5k implementation credit (applies if baseline acceptance is signed)
  * Checkpoint 5: $15k completion credit (applies on successful load test and NPS acceptance)
- Ramp pricing post-eval: three tiers (30 days, 60 days, 90 days) with step-down unit pricing as you ramp usage. I included committed capacity options with additional discounts at 6-month and 12-month commits.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1_20260911.pdf (MAP + milestone language)

Next steps I suggest: quick sync Monday to walk the MAP and agree on definitions for "baseline acceptance" and "successful load test." I can also loop in our finance lead if you want the credit mechanics spelled out in the SOW language.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-2104

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Sep 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: FW: MAP pricing scenarios — internal note

Folks — quick internal note on Vanessa’s MAP v1 for Clearwater. I reviewed the scenarios and flagged two items:

1) Discount banding: if Clearwater wants both a post-eval 6-mo commit and immediate committed capacity for production, we should offer a blended discount — 10% on committed baseline + an extra 5% if they hit the 90-day ramp target.
2) Credit accounting: the $20k total credit (5k+15k) is fine, but finance prefers credits to be applied as an invoice-level negative line rather than as an upfront refund. That keeps reporting clean.

I attached a short spreadsheet with three pricing permutations we can use during the call. My recommendation for the call: present Scenario B (moderate ramp, 6-mo commit) as default; show Scenario A (aggressive 12-mo) as upside.

Attachments: pricing-scenarios_20260912.xlsx

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions PM | Redwood Inference

From: Claire O'Neill <claire@clearwaterhealth.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation plan request + checkpoint credits?

Thanks Vanessa — we reviewed the MAP internally and have a couple of redlines:

- We can accept checkpoint credits as an invoice credit. Please confirm they will appear on the first operational invoice after evaluation.
- We’d like checkpoint 2 credit increased to $7.5k to cover professional services during onboarding.
- Data retention: we need a 365-day logs retention option for evaluation traces; can you confirm availability and any incremental cost?

If you can accept the bumped checkpoint 2 credit and confirm retention, we can sign the MAP and route to contracts for a quick execution.

—Claire

Subject: Re: Evaluation plan request + checkpoint credits? — updated MAP v2 attached

Claire / Evan — thanks for the quick review. We can accommodate the changes with two updates:

1) Checkpoint 2 credit increased to $7.5k as an invoice credit applied to the first operational invoice (per your request).
2) Logs retention: we’ll enable a 365-day retention tier for evaluation traces at a nominal $500/month during evaluation; after eval you can choose to retain or purge.

I attached Redwood_MAP_v2_20260916.pdf which includes the revised credit amounts, the invoice-credit language, and the retention option. Marcus and I adjusted the ramp language to include the blended discount approach for a 6-month commit.

Next steps: if this looks good, we’ll route to your contracts team and our legal (Hannah) for final sign-off and then send a DocuSign envelope for the MAP + SOW. I’ve also updated HubSpot with the preferred Scenario B economics.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v2_20260916.pdf

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
